data_source: 10 aligned SEVIR VIL test events with CasCast ensembles and ground truth

ensemble_validation.interpretation: spread-error相关、区间覆盖率、spread-skill ratio、可靠性曲线和rank histogram均由10路ensemble与真实未来帧共同计算；它们比只展示标准差更能检验不确定性是否可信。
